default_password.description: The plaintext password to pass via -p option. Highly discouraged for security reasons. Leave empty to use other methods.

default_password_file.description: Path to a file containing the password (first line). Used via -f option. File should have restricted permissions (e.g., 0400).

default_use_env.description: If true, uses the -e flag to read password from the SSHPASS environment variable. Recommended over -p.

command.description: The command to run after sshpass (typically ssh, scp, or rsync).

strict_host_key_checking.description: If false, adds -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no to the ssh command. Warning: this is insecure.

verbose.description: If true, adds -v flag to sshpass for verbose output to stderr.
